rows.gloss_cn: 探查、勘察(某地);(向…)显明、告知
rows.gloss_en: to explore or reconnoitre a place; to reveal or make known
rows.modern_en: to find or become aware of something for the first time
rows.example_en: At dawn we went inland to discover the country and seek fresh water.
rows.example_cn: 天亮时我们往内陆去探查这片地方,寻找淡水。

rows.gloss_en: keenly aware or conscious of something
rows.modern_en: showing good sense or sound judgement
rows.example_en: He was sensible of the danger long before the others took notice.
rows.example_cn: 他远在旁人察觉之前就意识到了危险。

rows.gloss_cn: (指人)年老的、故交;(航海)船旗、旗帜
rows.gloss_en: (of a person) very old and aged; (nautical) a ship's flag or ensign
rows.modern_en: belonging to the very distant past
rows.example_en: The ancient boatswain hoisted the ship's ancient as a signal of distress.
rows.example_cn: 那位年老的水手长升起船上的旗帜,发出遇险的信号。
